text:
Anjali: Heads-up — BigCorp is pushing hard for a 99.95% latency + availability SLA as part of renewal. They want it included in contract by EOW. Thoughts?

Sara: They said if we don't commit they'll talk to other vendors. Renewal next week. This is high risk.

Matt: 99.95 for inference on hosted tier is non-trivial. Need dedicated pools or stronger fallbacks. Cost impact estimate? :grimacing: 

Leo: Quick RICE attempt: Reach=9, Impact=8, Confidence=5, Effort=4 -> RICE ≈ (9*8*5)/4 = 90. Very rough, assumes reserved infra.

Anjali: Good start. We need concrete options: A) Offer SLA with reserved capacity + price bump; B) Offer operational SLA with credits only (no product guarantees); C) Hybrid: regional failover + credits.

Matt: A requires Dedicated ramp, capacity reservation, SLA playbook, automated failover, monitoring. Timeline 6-8 wks.

Jules: Also requires changes to console (per-customer SLA flags) and billing model. That's product + bizops.

ops-bot: cost-estimate: reserved-gpu-month ≈ $180k/mo for peak profile -> passing to finance for precise numbers.

Sara: Can we buy time with a "renewal addendum" promising roadmap prioritization and a pilot SLA for 3 months?

Leo: Pilot sounds less risky — gives us time to collect data, tune batching/kv cache, and try quantized variants for lower cost.

Matt: Agree. For pilot we can do canary customers, set SLO targets (p99 latency < 300ms, availability 99.9%), automated degradations to smaller model if misbehaving.

Anjali: Launch criteria for pilot: runbook, telemetry dashboards, rollbacks, SLO alerting, cost delta estimate, legal sign-off.

Sara: Sales needs a one-pager for BigCorp ASAP. I can frame pilot + credit terms.

Jules: I'll scope console changes minimal: tenant flag + SLA metadata + billing tag. Estimate 2 wks for a trimmed-down flow.

Matt: Engineering follow-ups: autoscale rules, KV cache pinning for tenant, dedicated pool config, and canary routing. I'll sketch tech spec by EOD.

Anjali: Action items: Matt spec, Jules console scoping, Finance PoC cost numbers, Legal draft pilot addendum, Sales one-pager. Sync tomorrow 9am.

Sara: Thanks — I'll communicate pilot offer to BigCorp and buy time.

Leo: For prioritization ranking vs other roadmap bets, let's add this to the RICE board and tag as "renewal-driven". If score stays high we can re-sequence.

Anjali: Agreed. If pilot fails or they push hard, escalate to execs. For now we avoid full SLA commit.

Sara: On it. :thumbsup: 

Matt: +1. Will include fallback policies in spec.

ops-bot: meeting created: #sla-pilot-sync 2025-11-05T09:00:00Z

Anjali: Thanks everyone. Keep replies short in thread and drop docs in the shared drive.
